business: Loom — shared agentic ecosystem for AI coding teams
target: Engineering leads and CTOs at teams running 3+ AI coding agents who want shared skills, sessions, MCP servers, and credentials without per-tool lock-in

behaviours.name: Daily regular
behaviours.how: Runs 3+ AI agents every day; context lost when switching tools

behaviours.name: Deal hunter
behaviours.how: Compares every AI tool on price per seat; switches for free tiers

behaviours.name: Reads every review
behaviours.how: Checks Reddit, GitHub issues, Twitter before buying any dev tool

behaviours.name: Loyal to a competitor
behaviours.how: Already pays for Cursor or Copilot; reluctant to add another tool

behaviours.name: Compliance buyer
behaviours.how: Needs SSO, audit log, FIPS before any purchase; slow procurement

objections: Another tool to manage — my team already has too many
Cursor/Copilot already do context sharing within their own editor
I don't trust a new vendor with my code and session data
$30/seat adds up fast when I have 10+ agents
My team uses different agents; I can't force them all onto one
Setup looks complex — daemon, adapters, MCP servers
What happens if Loom shuts down? My context is locked in
We already pay for GitHub Copilot Enterprise; why add this?
habits: Evaluates new dev tools on product-hunt-style launch days
Reads GitHub issues and Reddit before installing anything
Prefers CLI-first tools that script well
Buys on engineering-lead authority, not procurement committee
